latest.title: The stealthiest particle configurations in 8 and 24 dimensions
latest.abstract: We show that the $E_8$ and Leech lattices generate the stealthiest isometry-invariant, locally square-integrable point processes of intensity $1$ in $\mathbb{R}^8$ and $\mathbb{R}^{24}$, respectively, and that they are the unique stealthiest processes. We also apply the proof technique to sphere packing and energy minimization, and we construct a $20$-dimensional periodic configuration that is stealthier than any known $20$-dimensional lattice with the same particle density. This periodic configuration is a formal dual of Vardy's $20$-dimensional sphere packing.
latest.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
latest.workSummary: 证明在强度为 1 的等距不变、局部平方可积点过程中，E8 与 Leech 格分别唯一最大化八维和二十四维的 stealth 半径；并构造一个比已知同密度二十维格更 stealthy 的周期构型。
techniques: 点过程与二阶相关测度
结构因子与傅里叶分析
Cohn–Elkies 线性规划辅助函数
latest.breakthrough: 首次在包含晶体与无序竞争者的宽泛概率类中证明 E8/Leech 的最优性和唯一性；还给出首个已知“优于所有已知同维格”的周期 stealth 构型。
latest.limitations: 最优性只在 8、24 维并依赖等距不变与局部平方可积假设；20 维构型只优于已知格，不是全局最优证明。
latest.aiEvidence: GPT-5.5 Pro 参与搜索、化简并检查二十维 stealth 构型及其与 Vardy 堆积的形式对偶关系，作者随后核验计算；模型还提供编辑反馈。
latest.priorityReason: 把魔法辅助函数从球堆积反向用于散射谱，兼具强唯一性、可迁移技术和新的高维构型，是今日最重要结果之一。
